Of 22 patients interviewed, 13 (59%) had been exposed to rodents purchased from retail pet stores
were from Illinois, Kentucky, Missouri, Pennsylvania, and South Carolina (two cases each)
Six (40%) patients were hospitalized; no deaths occurred.
Seven (32%) of the 22 patients had no identified rodent exposure.
Two (9%) patients acquired salmonellosis through secondary exposure.
This report describes two of the first identified human cases associated with this outbreak
